name: clips/t4_river_oner
prompt: One continuous first-person POV shot, no cuts, no people anywhere. The camera walks slowly and steadily straight forward down the middle of the flooded riverside path in heavy rain, always facing straight ahead, gentle walking bob, the thin hood rim at the top of frame. The floodwater on the path gets deeper with every step. At about five seconds a bright flash of lightning lights the whole scene for a moment, then darkness, then a second shorter flash. The camera stops walking and tilts slowly straight down to your own white sneakers standing ankle-deep, fully submerged in dark rippling floodwater, rain hitting the surface, and holds there. Empty far bank, no figures, no statues. Realistic, cinematic 35mm film look, no text.
